meta.title: Veterinary history for French Bulldogs
meta.description: Turn your Frenchie's symptoms, photos, dates, and treatments into a clear report for every vet visit.
meta.keywords: french bulldog vet history, frenchie health report, dog vet tracker

hero.headline: How much time do you lose explaining the same thing to the vet at every visit?
hero.before: When was the last time he had that rash? Umm... maybe three months ago? Or four. And the previous vet prescribed... something. I do not remember the name.
hero.after: Here is the full history. Since March 3. 47 entries with photos. The highest spike was April 15, three days after changing food.

problem.title: Why vets hate missing history
problem.quote: Most clinical reasoning mistakes start with incomplete history. It is not the owner's fault: nobody remembers everything from memory.

passport.title: A PDF report that speaks your vet's language.
passport.body: Frenchie Care gathers timeline, photos, dates, food, symptoms, treatments, vaccines, and notes. Share it by link or print it before the appointment starts.

testimonials.title: What changes when you arrive with tracking
items: Placeholder vet: When an owner brings dates and photos, I can ask better questions in less time.
Placeholder owner: I stopped feeling like I was improvising at every visit.

demo.title: Mini demo: what would you tell your vet?
demo.placeholder: Write what you remember from the last 30 days...
demo.button: Versus what Frenchie Care would have?
demo.result: Last 30 days: 12 logs, 5 photos, average itch 6/10, peak 9/10 on April 15, changed to chicken food on April 12, two ear episodes, and one bath note before the flare.

cta.title: The next vet visit can be completely different.

footer.tagline: Less improvised memory. More veterinary context.
footer.disclaimer: Frenchie Care organizes information. Your veterinarian diagnoses and decides treatments.
